name: Exfil-guard (one-shot credential exfiltration tripwire)
summary: a PreToolUse hook for the Bash tool that denies a single command combining a secret path with a network egress tool (the fetch tools, nc, /dev/tcp…) — the classic one-shot credential exfiltration shape the file-read deny floor does not cover; fails OPEN on parse errors and only ever ADDS a deny
requires: a Claude Code hooks block in settings.json
retires: reading every Bash command of an agent session for the read-then-send shape
